Net_Strand.channels: tiles in U (one tile per 0.25 m), V across. R two braided filaments, G soft glow, B beads at the crossings. Additive, tint = the net colour

Net_Strand.note: 1 long along Unity X (FromToRotation(Vector3.right, b - a)), scale X by the strand length; U tiles 4 per metre (set the material tiling to length*4 or use world UVs)
